source: Open Images V6 validation, disjoint source IDs for fit/calibration/demo
fit_selection: Largest eligible non-depiction/non-group/non-truncated bounding box, area >=0.15, normalized aspect ratio 0.6 to 1.7; sort unique source IDs by SHA256 of pca-demo-2026-11-04:ID. Exclude all 8 demo source IDs. First 2048 fit, next 128 calibration.
training_note: PCA was fitted for this demo. TAESD uses its author's pretrained weights; its original training images may overlap public datasets. This is a qualitative comparison of these fitted models.
quantizer: Uniform affine quantization per coordinate. Ranges are calibration minima/maxima from 128 separate images, stored as two 1024-value float32 arrays per method. Integer values are actually bit-packed. Reported per-image payload excludes these 8192 shared range bytes and shared decoder/basis.
metric: MSE on RGB values scaled to [0,1], after decoded output is clipped to [0,1] and before PNG rounding. RMSE is shown on the 0 to 255 scale.
